Dolly Parton leaves behind a legacy that extends far beyond her music.

Throughout her life, Parton gave back through philanthropic efforts that supported childhood literacy, medical research and people in need, particularly in her home state of Tennessee. https://t.co/dMsBGqISBT

The father of a sailor deployed aboard the USS Abraham Lincoln aircraft carrier was released by immigration authorities Tuesday — days after his son posted about the ordeal on Facebook, an account not disputed by the Department of Homeland Security. https://t.co/uWY2drHZTL

The State Department announced that it is preparing to revoke tourist and business visas issued between 2016 and 2026 to foreign nationals who have sought or are actively seeking asylum in the U.S. https://t.co/dXzD9bxY5e
